name: selfroles
author: kirin
short: Dropdown menus where members pick their own roles.
description: One message per category with a banner, the role list, a dropdown and a Clear button. Admins create and post categories with commands; staff add and remove roles with commands or on the staff dashboard. Roles with moderator permissions can't be put on a menu.
install_msg: Create a category with `[p]selfroles create <max picks> <name>`, add roles with `[p]selfroles addrole`, then `[p]selfroles post` it.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no user data. It keeps its menus' settings: category names, role and emoji lists, and where each menu is posted.
